castTime.binNote: Wiki gives a dynamic cast time formula 1.2/(1+bonusAS/100) capped at 0.6s (base 1.2 at 0 bonus AS); the sheet's KaisaE castTime field instead states a flat 1.5, and the calculation it should come from (KaisaE#TotalCastTime) depends on an unresolved 'ClampSubPartsCalculationPart', so the two sources disagree and the bin's own formula cannot be verified.

values.meaning: Bonus Attack Speed gained after the charge completes
values.binNote: No KaisaE data value or calculation in the sheet carries this bonus attack speed amount; only cast-time and movespeed formulas reference bonus attack speed as an input.

values.quote: she gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 4 seconds
values.binNote: No KaisaE data value in the sheet carries this 4-second buff duration; it appears only in the wiki description text.

values.meaning: current cooldown reduction per attack while active
values.binNote: No KaisaE data value in the sheet carries this 0.5s on-attack cooldown refund; it appears only in the wiki description text.

mechanics.claim: The cast time itself shrinks with bonus attack speed (down to a floor of 0.6s), so more bonus attack speed lets Kai'Sa reach the attack-speed buff faster.
mechanics.quote: 1.2 /(1 + '''bonus''' attack speed/100) . ''This is capped at 0.6 seconds.''

mechanics.claim: During the 4-second post-charge buff, Kai'Sa's attacks have reduced windup and increased missile speed, both increasing effective attack speed/DPS.
mechanics.quote: her attacks have a lower {{tip|attack windup|windup}} of {{ap|(0.1/{{ccd|Kai'Sa|attack_total_time}})*100|round=2}}% and an increased missile speed

mechanics.claim: Each of Kai'Sa's attacks reduces Supercharge's remaining cooldown by 0.5 seconds, so more attacks during the fight bring the ability back faster.
During the cast time, attack commands are converted into movement commands, so Kai'Sa cannot attack while charging Supercharge; any issued attack resumes automatically once the charge completes.
mechanics.quote: Her attack commands during this time are switched to movement commands instead. Upon finishing the charge and if an attack command was issued, '''Kai'Sa''' will continue walking toward her target.

mechanics.claim: During the cast time Kai'Sa is ghosted and gains bonus movement speed, which does not affect either fight.
mechanics.quote: becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{As|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for the duration
